rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is slightly or by a small amount.

example.english: This restaurant’s location is marginally inconvenient.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅位置有少少唔方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 wai6 zi3 jau5 siu2 siu2 m4 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this when marginally means barely sufficiently or only just managing to do something, rather than simply slightly.

example.english: I marginally have enough money to pay the rent.
example.jyutping: ngo5 min5 koeng5 gau3 cin4 gaau1 zou1
